topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
consensus_response: Prioritizing high-revenue services over navigation safety margins reduces link budget due to increased interference, decreasing signal-to-noise ratio and capacity. Adaptive modulation schemes like ACM mitigate this by optimizing SNR, but may not fully compensate for reduced link margin. Effective resource allocation strategies are necessary.
reference_context: QoS provisioning in satellite networks requires managing available capacity and link characteristics to ensure reliable communication.
